whenToUse: Representing a person or organisation in rows, cards, comments, pickers and menus.
Presence (online, away) next to a person.
avoidWhen: Decorative illustrations or product images — use Image.
a11y: Give the person's name as alt or adjacent text; when the name is already visible, mark the avatar decorative.
Presence must also be available as text (aria-label or tooltip).
